name: Albert Rösti
bio: Albert Rösti is a Swiss politician and businessman who has served as a member of the Swiss Federal Council since 1 January 2023, heading the Federal Department of the Environment, Transport, Energy and Communications (DETEC/UVEK). Born on 7 August 1967 in Kandersteg, canton of Bern, into a Protestant mountain-farming family, he trained as an agronomist at ETH Zurich, where he earned a doctorate (1997), and later completed an MBA at the University of Rochester / Rochester-Bern (2002). He worked as an agricultural-studies teacher, deputy then secretary general of the Bern cantonal Department of Economic Affairs, director of the Swiss Milk Producers (Swissmilk), and from 2013 ran his own business and political consultancy, Büro Dr. Rösti GmbH. He was president of the SVP of canton Bern and national president of the SVP from 2016 to 2020. He sat in the National Council for Bern from 2011 to 2022, and before his election held numerous board and lobbying mandates, including the presidency of the fuel-traders' association Swissoil. He was elected to the Federal Council on 7 December 2022, succeeding Ueli Maurer.
